title: Run strict opaque-output admission after staged DXF emission

source.fixturePolicy: Used the existing local sample matching its recorded digest. No DWG/DXF fixture was added to Git.

behavior: Strict complete-DWG output qualification runs from dx_iface::finalizeDxfWrite after the codec serializes and flushes a transactional temporary DXF, before DwgDxfOutputTransaction commits the destination.
The strict check remains closed when a source callback identity has no output qualification; retained callback bytes and aggregate counters do not pass it.
The check's reason is reported at finalization, preserving the diagnostic while allowing output observers and serializers to run against unpublished bytes.
limitations: No opaque callback identity is qualified by this slice; strict conversion remains refused.
Per-family field, ownership/dependency, emitted-byte and fresh-readback output proofs remain open.
The strict gate checks current output qualifications already stored in dx_data; transactional staging of new per-attempt qualifications must be in place before new proof producers are connected.

coverage: Strict admission runs at writer finalization after staged emission rather than at preflight.
A pre-existing destination sentinel survives refusal, proving the unpublished attempt does not replace it.
A subsequent non-strict retry on the same adapter succeeds and cleans up its destination.

strictCheckpoint.result: REFUSED in writer finalization after staged output generation; the requested destination was not published.
strictCheckpoint.diagnostic: strict-complete conversion requires output qualification for every opaque DWG callback

validation.fullSuites: NOT RUN; one focused adapter selector and one strict CLI checkpoint used.

planImpact.completedActionRemoved: Move strict output admission to the transactional writer-finalization point, after staged bytes exist and before destination publication.
planImpact.nextAction: Stage per-attempt output identities transactionally, then bind the highest-incidence callback family to complete typed output or a proven replay route with owner/dependency closure and fresh readback. Keep strict publication blocked until every required identity is qualified.
